prompt:
Design a high-fidelity desktop web page comp, landscape 16:10, for the Protocolo Lupita citizen homepage. Show the real webpage surface, with legible Spanish UI, not a poster.

COMPOSITION OPTION B — a wide civic directory: a short deep-navy header with the supplied shield and concise navigation; beneath it, a full-width off-white title band with the exact question “¿Recibiste un mensaje o una llamada sospechosa?” and a one-line explanation. The middle half of the screen is a single, continuous wayfinding rail that starts at a small gold origin mark and branches into three broad destination plaques arranged horizontally: “Revisar un SMS”, “Hacer un reporte”, “Consultar avisos”. The SMS destination is primary by fill and contrast. Keep the directory rail and plaques large enough to read, without framing each as a separate rounded card. Along the bottom, a smaller government route and a concise note “Demostración local · datos ficticios”. This composition is deliberately different from the reference comp’s left-copy/right-map split: the visitor meets the question first, then the service directory spans the page as one integrated route system.

WORLD REFERENCE: the attached reference comp defines only the civic-wayfinding material, broad geometric typography, dense navy-and-gold signage, warm off-white field, route-marker behavior, and the Protocolo Lupita shield placement. The separate original shield image defines the exact logo; preserve it unchanged. Do not copy the reference comp’s layout. Keep the product’s exact dark navy #10213F, warm off-white #F3F0E6, and gold #D5A928 palette. Strong readable type and generous spacing; crisp, high-contrast, precise. No gradients, stock imagery, rounded card grid, maps claiming real activity, fake counts, testimonials, live metrics, or invented product capabilities. The page should be immediately legible as a public service helping a resident choose a next step.
